artworks.title: Study for a Border Design [recto]
artworks.medium: watercolor, gold paint, and graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: This is a painting of a geometric pattern with abstract and organic elements. The image features intersecting lines and shapes forming a lattice-like background in earthy tones of brown and green. Two elongated leaf-like shapes are seen over this pattern, with subtle touches of blue along the edges. The artwork is minimalist, relying on texture and pattern.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image displays a series of curved and looping shapes organized in a symmetrical pattern. The shapes resemble stylized bells or petal-like forms, connected by lines and surrounded by smaller circular elements. In the center, a more intricate arrangement of these elements forms a pattern. The overall design suggests an abstract decorative motif, potentially used in design or textile work.

artworks.title: Tracing of a Border Design
artworks.medium: graphite and red pencil on yellow tracing paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative architectural or sculptural element. The drawing features intricate, flowing designs. The central portion includes two large leaf-like forms extending from opposite ends, meeting at a central point. The top of the drawing is lined with a series of rectangular notches, while the bottom displays a pattern reminiscent of rolling waves. Shadows and lines are used to give dimension to the design and notes and measurements appear along the edges, indicating its purpose as a study or plan for the carving or building of this element.

artworks.title: Tracing of a Border Design
artworks.medium: graphite with purple and green pencils on yellow tracing paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a floral design with leaves and berries. The composition features a central branch extending vertically with clusters of elongated leaves and round berries. The background is filled with a pattern that includes purple shading and a pencil-sketched border with a wavy line design. The paper has visible creases, and some handwritten notes are present on the margins of the sheet. The color palette is soft, relying heavily on graphite with a touch of subtle purple to fill in the spaces between the elements.

artworks.title: Tracing of a Border Design
artworks.medium: graphite on yellow tracing paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows elongated leaf-like shapes aligned vertically on the page, with round circle-like forms at the top and bottom sections. There are curving wave-like lines at the edges, creating an abstract pattern resembling plant tendrils or decorative frills.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: gouache and graphite on brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image displays a symmetrical arrangement of elongated leaves on a brown stem, accompanied by clusters of round berries. The color palette includes soft greens, beiges, light browns, and subtle blush pinks against a beige background. The leaves are painted in a vertical orientation, emanating from the central stem, with the berries positioned adjacent to some leaves. A decorative wave pattern runs along the right side of the image, with a similar color scheme harmonizing with the main botanical motif.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: graphite and gold paint on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image consists of swirling brown lines forming a complex pattern. The lines interweave to create an abstract composition. The texture is granular, resembling ancient parchment or a celestial map. The frame of the image is bordered by a lighter shade.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: graphite, watercolor, and gold paint on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows a stylized plant with large, pointed green leaves and small clusters of pink flowers. The leaves and flowers feature soft greens, pinks, and browns. The plant's large green leaves are centered, with pink flowers dispersed near the leaves. The background is textured brown.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: graphite and gold paint on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image displays elongated, curved shapes and lines converging at a central point to form a symmetrical pattern resembling a branching structure. The shapes suggest the likeness of a tree or plant with long leaves extending outward and small circular forms scattered among them. The earthy tones and textured background add to the impression of organic matter.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: graphite and watercolor on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows a series of curved and linear shapes forming an abstract composition. Green crescent shapes overlap with dark, squared lines and earthy brown curved forms, creating a rhythmic pattern. The shapes intertwine, giving the impression of interlocking gears or sinuous movement, inviting exploration of the abstract connectivity.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: watercolor, gold paint, and graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows a central design with large, symmetrical leaf-like shapes arranged in an alternating pattern along a vertical axis against a blue background. The composition is bordered by swirling, wave-like patterns. Overlapping circles are interspersed among the leaves, adding a rhythmic flow to the design.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: graphite and pen and black ink on brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image depicts a stylized floral design with a symmetrical arrangement of leaves and round fruits or berries. The composition consists of elongated, curved lines outlining the elements against a plain background. In the center, two sets of large leaves are surrounded by groups of three circle shapes resembling berries. To the left, there are sketches of individual leaves. The style is linear, abstract, and geometric, emphasizing form and symmetry without color.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: gouache, gold paint, and graphite on blue wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows an abstract design with a central vertical line and symmetrical, curved leaf-like shapes on each side. Alongside this pattern is a series of small, repetitive wave-like curls forming a border. The abstract shapes resemble stylized branches, evoking natural elements like leaves and vines. The designs are set against a soft blue background.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: gold paint, pen and black ink, and watercolor on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image contains a design comprised of a curved rectangle decorated with geometric shapes resembling a zigzag pattern. The central straight line runs vertically through the design. Overlapping layers of geometric forms mimic the structure of a fern or a feather. A repetitive pattern of elongated ovals on either side of the central line creates a motif similar to leaves or scales. The design blends abstract and organic elements, set against a background of light blue shading contrasting with the earthy tones of the central design.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: gold paint, watercolor, gouache, and graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows a tall rectangular shape with a vertical arrangement of lines and forms. Within the composition, there are green, leaf-like shapes symmetrically placed on either side of a central axis. Above each set of leaves are circular, red shapes. The design is framed by a subtle wave-like pattern on one side.

artworks.description: The image shows a central vertical composition of angular shapes resembling large, elongated leaves and circular, berry-like forms. The design incorporates a symmetrical arrangement that draws on botanical forms, resembling a stylized plant or branch. On the right edge, small, repeating, wave-like lines run parallel to the central composition, enhancing the design's aesthetic appeal. The image is a structured abstract representation of plant elements.

artworks.title: Sketches for a Scroll
artworks.medium: pen and black ink, watercolor, and graphite on brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows a series of linear scroll-like shapes running horizontally across a tan background. The abstract rendering includes lines tapering into spirals or curls at the ends. Some shapes are detailed with textured lines suggesting layers and creases, similar to a rolled-up paper partially unfurled. The forms are repeated in various sizes throughout the image, creating a sense of layered repetition.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: gold paint, watercolor, and graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows a composition of zigzag and angular shapes converging along a central vertical line resembling the spine of a leaf. The abstract arrangement features a combination of earthy brown, muted green, and deep blue colors against a plain backdrop. The curved boundary enclosing the pattern forms an elongated arch.

artworks.title: Henham Park, Suffolk
artworks.medium: graphite with watercolor on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a high horizon line, sailing ships in the distance, delicate brushstrokes creating a soft feel, a color palette of pastels and earth tones, trees with minimal foliage, dense greenery, and a sky with soft clouds.

artworks.title: Paysanne bêchant (Peasant Laboring)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in black touched with graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Martin and Liane W. Atlas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rustic outdoor scene featuring farm elements. The image depicts a person working the land with a tool, surrounded by birds in the foreground. There are barren trees around the perimeter of the scene, and a couple of cottages with steep roofs in the background. The drawing uses intricate line work and shading to convey textures and forms, emphasizing the natural environment and the simplicity of rural life.

artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.dimensions:

support: 45.4 x 60.6 cm (17 7/8 x 23 7/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a railway station with train tracks extending towards the viewer. The station building is grand and symmetrical, designed with glass panels and metalwork. The horizon is visible through the station arch, with faint outlines of buildings in the distance. Freight carriages flank the station, and the color palette is sepia-toned, enhancing the details and contrasts in the photograph.

artworks.title: Julia Jackson
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up portrait of a person's face and upper shoulders. The person is positioned facing forward, with their face directed at the camera. Their facial features are softly blurred, and the lighting creates a dim yet even glow across their eyes, nose, and mouth. The person has smooth, straight hair, parted in the middle. They are wearing a dark top with a pattern of small, light-colored beads or embellishments, and a scalloped, lighter collar at the neckline. The background is indistinct and blurred. No visible jewelry or objects are present.
